name: math_isomorphism

VINIT.justification: the initial object before any structure or mapping is defined

TANCH.justification: the terminal boundary containing all equivalent structures

AFWD.justification: the forward mapping from source structure to target structure

AREV.justification: the reverse mapping from target structure back to source structure

CLINK.justification: the sequential chaining of the forward and reverse mappings

IMSCRIB.justification: the self-referential mapping where the structure maps to itself

FSPLIT.justification: the separation of a structure into its underlying set and its algebraic relations

FFUSE.justification: the reconstitution of the set and relations into the original structure

EVALT.justification: the affirmative state where the mapping is both injective and surjective

EVALF.justification: the negative state where structural properties are not preserved

ENGAGR.justification: a state where structure is preserved but bijectivity is not yet resolved

IFIX.justification: the permanent record of the equivalence between two structures

phase_3.void_description: unmapped space before the definition of sets or morphisms
phase_3.true_description: successful verification of the isomorphism condition
phase_3.false_description: failure to map elements or preserve operations
phase_3.both_description: a mapping that preserves structure but lacks a unique inverse

steps.domain_action: identify the source structure as a self-consistent entity
decompose the source structure into its constituent set and operations
apply the forward morphism to the set and operations
verify the mapping is surjective and injective
reconstitute the target structure from the mapped components
identify the target structure as a self-consistent entity
decompose the target structure for the return mapping
apply the inverse morphism to the target components
check for any loss of structural integrity during descent
compose the forward and reverse morphisms to test for identity
hold the relational mapping in a state of structural preservation
record the formal proof of isomorphism in the catalog
close the system within the isomorphism class boundary

phase_5.compiler_frontend: formal logic and set theory axioms

phase_6.pre_cycle_state: two distinct structures with unknown relation
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the information content remains constant through reversible mapping
